description:
Use this when the user asks who owns an Indian company listed on NSE or BSE: promoter, FII, DII, mutual fund and public holding percentages by quarter. Not for daily buying or selling; for daily FII/DII flow use get_market_fii_dii_flow or get_stock_fii_flow.

Returns the shareholding pattern for each quarter, newest first: promoter, FII, DII and non-promoter percentages with the change from the quarter before, the promoters' pledged shares as a percentage of their own holding and of all shares, and, where available, institutions split by type and the holders named in the filing. `limit` is the number of quarters (default 8, at most 20). For the pledge series alone use get_pledge_trend.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query

name: get_shareholding
title: Shareholding pattern
